description: Create an editable short link and QR on the signed-in account. The destination can be changed later with update_dynamic_qr without reprinting the code. This requires an Editable credit or a plan that includes editable codes. Use this when the user will print or share a code whose target may change (menus, campaigns, packaging). Use create_fixed_link for a non-editable hosted link, create_static_qr for a throwaway image with no account, and bulk_create_dynamic_qrs for many editable codes at once (Scan Pass or Business). `destinationUrl` is required. `title` is an optional label. `customSlug` is an optional custom short-link slug if the plan allows it. `idempotencyKey` prevents duplicate creates on retry.

customSlug.description: Optional custom short-link slug if the plan allows it

idempotencyKey.description: Prevents duplicate creates or updates on retry (max 64 characters)

name: create_dynamic_qr
title: Make editable code
